from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """Record of total liabilities for a specific company in its financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the statement")
    liabilities_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of total liabilities as reported in the document")
    liabilities_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for which these liabilities are reported")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text describing the liability figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
